name: keep-cache-warm
description: Keeps the Claude prompt cache warm: a bar above the prompt with Keep warm, Compact and Warm-then-compact modes, a status-line countdown, and a ping or compaction about 5 minutes before the 1-hour cache expires.

defaultMode.title: Start each session in
defaultMode.description: The mode every new session starts in. off leaves it to you: pick a mode in the bar. A mode here means every session you open pings while you are away, up to the budget below.

maxPings.title: Pings in a row before pausing
maxPings.description: Keep-alive pings in a row with no message from you before Keep warm pauses and Warm then compact compacts instead (1 to 50), in each session. Each ping is a billed model call.

fallbackPing.title: Ping when a compaction fails
fallbackPing.description: If a compaction fails, send one keep-alive ping in its place (it counts against the ping budget) so the cache is still warm when you come back.

maxPingsPerDay.title: Daily ping cap, all sessions
maxPingsPerDay.description: Most keep-alive pings per day (UTC) across every session on this machine; past it, keep-warm pauses until you press Resume or the next day. 0 means no cap.
